name: ReSpeaker XVF3800 USB 4-Mic Array
description: Seeed ReSpeaker 4-mic circular array driven by the XMOS XVF3800 DSP. The DSP does beamforming, de-reverberation, acoustic echo cancellation and direction-of-arrival on-device, so the host receives one already-cleaned mono stream rather than four raw capsules.

meta.notes: Enumerates as a UAC composite device: one capture stream, one playback stream, plus a vendor-specific control interface used for device management. No kernel driver is needed for audio.

name: C-Media USB Audio Adapter (capture)
description: Capture side of the common C-Media USB audio adapter, sold under many brand names. A UAC composite device with one capture and one playback stream; no kernel driver is needed.

meta.notes: USB signature read from a live device on a MonsterNet node via /sys/bus/usb/devices. It identifies the MODEL, not the individual unit, so an identical replacement adapter still matches. C-Media licenses this controller to many resellers and the descriptor strings are generic by design - read a match as 'same adapter model', not 'same brand'. This is a near-field adapter for a headset or lapel capsule; it does no beamforming or echo cancellation.
